title: Anonymous sources: bodies came from a subterranean tunnel system

tellings.quote: A few different anonymous sources revealed to me that the actual source of these bodies is a large subterranean tunnel system.

plain: The small, three-fingered bodies that turned up in the Nazca region of Peru came out of a large underground tunnel system, according to several anonymous sources who Michels says told him so. He does not name them or describe the tunnels further. If true, it would mean the bodies were not made or dug up at random but came from one hidden place.
